{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute overall conversion rates for each channel (raw difference)
email_conversion_rate = completed_df[completed_df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_conversion_rate = completed_df[completed_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
raw_difference = email_conversion_rate - paid_search_conversion_rate

# Print raw conversion rates and difference
print(f'Email conversion rate (raw): {email_conversion_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Paid search conversion rate (raw): {paid_search_conversion_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Raw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_difference:.4f}')"}
